title: pinus yunnanensis subsp. pygmaea
intro: Pinus yunnanensis subsp. pygmaea, commonly known as Yunnan fir, is a small to medium-sized evergreen coniferous tree native to China. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include promoting health and relieving stress due to its adaptogenic and antioxidant effects. The health benefits of Yunnan fir include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system, while its therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-anxiety and anti-depressive agent, and also as an anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidant agent. The bioactive constituents of Pinus yunnanensis subsp. pygmaea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
